title: Now Live: The Slash App, Now on Android
summary: Slash is now on Android. Manage cards, complete tasks, attach receipts, and send payments from anywhere.
body_markdown:
## Business Banking, Built for Android¹


Running your business doesn’t stop when you leave your desk. A payment needs to go out, a card needs to be paused, or an approval lands while you’re between meetings. Now Android users can handle all of it from the Slash app.


[Slash’s new Android app](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.slash.mobile) brings the core tools you use to run your company’s finances onto your phone—from banking and cards to everyday admin. It’s made for quick decisions on the go, with fast navigation, a clear interface, and secure access through biometric authentication.


## Move money your way


Slash for Android supports the payment methods businesses rely on, whether you’re paying a nearby vendor or moving funds across borders. Eligible users can:


- Send ACH payments
- Send domestic and international wires
- Make real-time payments
- Add funds from a connected bank account or by wire
- Send and receive USDC and USDT on 15 blockchains⁴
- Deposit crypto and convert between stablecoins and fiat


## Less catching up, more moving forward


The Action Center brings outstanding tasks into one place, so you can see what’s waiting on you without searching across your account. Missing receipts, reimbursement requests, approvals, and onboarding tasks are surfaced in a single queue based on your role and permissions.


Open an item to review the relevant context, take the next step, and keep work moving. Once an item is complete, its status updates automatically, giving you a simple view of what’s done and what still needs attention.


Plus, your Slash app will keep you in the know with push notifications for authorizations, card activity, account updates, and important security events.


## More control from your pocket


Small financial tasks have a way of turning into a long list by the end of the day. Slash for Android lets you take care of them in the moment, from managing a card to attaching a receipt. You can:


- Create virtual cards and securely view card details
- Review card activity and adjust spending limits
- Pause or close company cards
- Capture and attach receipts directly to transactions
- Search and filter account activity
- Switch between business entities with biometric authentication


Team members see only the accounts, cards, and actions available to their role. That keeps the experience focused while helping protect sensitive business information.


### [A better way to bank on Android. Click here to download Slash on the Google Play Store today.](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.slash.mobile)


## Apply in less than 10 minutes today


Join the 10,000+ businesses already using Slash.
